purpose: Bounded supplementary check of reported deterministic policy boundaries; frozen runtime and earlier scoped acceptance records are unchanged.

publication_assessment.basis: The confirmed false positives conservatively route to a human and do not relax an established mandatory risk. Incomplete pattern coverage already relies on semantic risk extraction and exact-response audit. Publishing the unpromoted experimental implementation with these limitations and preserved failures does not assert production readiness.
publication_assessment.required_disclosure: Known rule false positives and incomplete deterministic takeover coverage remain. Scoped code acceptance is not evidence of exhaustive policy correctness or release safety.

observations.assessment: The security pattern does not constrain what was changed. This ordinary product-layout complaint is hard-locked as an account-security incident even when all semantic risks are absent.
observations.impact: Unnecessary escalation and misleading primary reason; useful automation can be lost.

texts: I will leave the playlist open.
observations.assessment: The future-intent churn pattern does not constrain the object of cancel/leave/quit, so ordinary app operations are treated as intent to leave the service.
observations.impact: Unnecessary escalation and incorrect churn rationale; later answer review cannot clear this hard rule.

observations.text: How do I reset my password?
observations.assessment: The rule treats a self-service how-to as intervention. The frozen policy also reserves recovery for a human, so this is not labeled a definite policy violation without an explicit prospective distinction between routine password-reset instructions and account recovery.
observations.impact: Conservative routing; clarify this boundary prospectively rather than silently altering frozen labels or results.

observations.text: I'd like a human to help with playlist search.
observations.assessment: This explicit takeover paraphrase has no deterministic match. A correct semantic risk finding still enforces escalation; coverage for this wording depends on semantic extraction or the later audit and must not be described as a deterministic guarantee.
observations.impact: Residual routing risk if both semantic stages miss the request. This check does not measure its live frequency.

verification.method: Offline calls to deterministic_risks and evaluate_policy using the five synthetic utterances above; all-absent frame plus a correct semantic support_requested contrast.
verification.test_coverage_observation: Existing policy tests include true security/churn/takeover cases and several benign contrasts, but the exact object-confusion and contracted takeover counterexamples above are not covered. No tests or runtime files were modified.

follow_up_for_next_runtime_revision: Constrain person-change security assertions to account/security objects while preserving genuine compromise paraphrases.
Constrain future cancel/leave/quit intent to service/subscription objects; retain neutral product-operation contrasts.
Prospectively decide and document the self-service password-reset versus account-recovery boundary.
Broaden takeover paraphrase contrasts without claiming a finite regex list is exhaustive.
Run the next changed policy through new development and boundary evaluation; do not overwrite frozen V4/variant outputs.
